title: When the Asset Burns
author: X. M. Thornbury
blurb: Beatrix Dunmore, a whistle-blower living under four names, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
